cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've copied your circles onto the party log. All columns equal. What time did you arrive, leave and visit the kitchen?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was circling stains. Are you asking about the missing cake?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stains noted. The cake can have its own line. What time did you arrive?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was late. Your cake was already cut by then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put 'late' until you can check. Now departure; I'm not leaving blanks on either side.

reason: Replace the original repeated kitchen priority with actual attention to arrival and departure after B suspects the cake motive. Copied stain notation becomes A's cover for evenly completing the account.
